title: Classify all closed one-forms on the punctured plane
promptMarkdown: Let $\alpha$ be a smooth closed one-form on $\mathbb R^2\setminus\{0\}$. Pull it back to $(0,\infty)\times\mathbb R$ as $A(r,\theta)dr+B(r,\theta)d\theta$. Prove the period $c(r)=\int_0^{2\pi}B(r,\theta)d\theta$ is constant. Construct a primitive on the covering, determine its change under $\theta\mapsto\theta+2\pi$, and conclude $\alpha-(c/2\pi)\omega$ is exact. State all de Rham groups of the punctured plane, justifying the higher-degree assertion by a deformation retraction and the homotopy operator.
hintLadder: Use closedness before differentiating the period.
Integrate first radially along angle zero, then angularly at the current radius.
Subtract the angular drift to make the potential periodic.
